auth.label: API Key
auth.description: SimplyBook.me API key used with the company login to request JSON-RPC access tokens. Enable the API Custom Feature and find keys in its Settings: https://help.simplybook.me/index.php/API_custom_feature.

extraFields.label: Company Login
extraFields.description: The SimplyBook.me company login passed to getToken and X-Company-Login for API calls.

actions.name: get_available_units
actions.description: Get performer ids available for a SimplyBook.me service at a specific date-time.

dateTime.description: The requested date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

count.description: The booking count used for availability checks.

inputSchema.description: Input for finding performers available for one service and date-time.

performerIds.description: Performer unit ids available for the requested slot.

actions.name: get_company_info
actions.description: Get public company profile and configuration details from SimplyBook.me.

inputSchema.description: Input for fetching SimplyBook.me company information.

name.description: The company name returned by SimplyBook.me.

login.description: The company login returned by SimplyBook.me.

email.description: The company email returned by SimplyBook.me.

timezone.description: The company timezone returned by SimplyBook.me.

actions.name: get_start_time_matrix
actions.description: Get available SimplyBook.me start times for a service and performer over a date range.

from.description: The first date to include in YYYY-MM-DD format.

to.description: The last date to include in YYYY-MM-DD format.

count.description: The booking count used for availability checks.

inputSchema.description: Input for querying available start times for one service and performer.

items.description: A start time in HH:mm:ss format.

additionalProperties.description: Start times returned for the date.

timesByDate.description: Available start times keyed by date.

outputSchema.description: The SimplyBook.me start time matrix response.

actions.name: list_performers
actions.description: List SimplyBook.me service performers that can provide services.

isVisibleOnly.description: Whether to return only records visible on the public booking site.

inputSchema.description: Options for listing public SimplyBook.me records.

id.description: The performer unit id returned by SimplyBook.me.

name.description: The performer name returned by SimplyBook.me.

email.description: The performer email returned by SimplyBook.me.

is_active.description: Whether the performer is active in SimplyBook.me.

actions.name: list_services
actions.description: List SimplyBook.me public service events available for booking.

isVisibleOnly.description: Whether to return only records visible on the public booking site.

inputSchema.description: Options for listing public SimplyBook.me records.

id.description: The service event id returned by SimplyBook.me.

name.description: The service name returned by SimplyBook.me.

duration.description: The service duration returned by SimplyBook.me.

is_public.description: Whether the service is public in SimplyBook.me.

is_active.description: Whether the service is active in SimplyBook.me.
